title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-21
lineage: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC
source: most likely MR > R @3 & 3/4 ips - dub of Jerry's reel left at a girlfriends house done by Will Boswell was done back in the Spring of '79

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a magical Spectrum show with superb Truckin', The Other One and Wharf Rat performances.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear, well‑balanced sound that showcases the famed 1973 Spectrum system, while the performance shines – highlighted by an inspired Truckin' → The Other One → Wharf Rat sequence, a tasty Weather Report jam, and a horn‑backed Casey Jones encore. Reviewers uniformly praise both the musical flow and the audio fidelity, calling it one of the standout shows of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are highly positive (average 4.7 stars), emphasizing both excellent show moments and a pristine soundboard recording, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviews highlight the crisp, clear Spectrum magic and the superb 1973 sound system; no glitches or muffiness are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set order was corrected for the second set, delivering a smooth, flowing performance with a standout jam into The Other One and a memorable horn‑enhanced encore.
